findings.evidence: The theorem states `(f4DividedSquareCoeff k b : ZMod 2) = 0 ↔ ...` and is required internally at lines 396 and 427 to connect the public table coefficient to root weights.
findings.fix: Export this theorem as part of the `f4DividedSquareCoeff` API (and give it an appropriate public name).
findings.issue: `f4DividedSquareCoeff_eq_zero_iff` is private even though it is the only semantic characterization of when the public coefficient vanishes modulo two; downstream users otherwise must unfold implementation tables.

findings.evidence: The previous declaration was `@[simp]`; the replacement at line 67 has no annotation, while `mapValue_tangentScalarExtensionEquiv_commAlgCat` at line 88 remains tagged.
findings.issue: The newly generalized `mapValue_tangentScalarExtensionEquiv` lost its `@[simp]` annotation, so the canonical naturality equation does not simplify for the broader `AlgHom` API; only the narrower category wrapper does.

summary: The public API hides a characteristic coefficient theorem and drops the expected simplification behavior from the generalized scalar-extension lemma.
